chart.title: Wheat yields
chart.subtitle: Yields are measured in tonnes per hectare.
chart.citation: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025) and other sources

Wheat yield.descriptionShort: Harvested production per unit of harvested area for wheat.
Wheat yield.descriptionKey:
- In most of the cases yield data are not recorded but obtained by dividing the production data by the data on area harvested.
- Data on yields of permanent crops are not as reliable as those for temporary crops.
